title: It works, but it seems very thin and fragile
text: It works, but it seems very thin and fragile. The good news is that it fits, but I'm not sure it will hold up to daily use.  We ordered an OEM replacement (more expensive but also more substantial) and are keeping this as a backup should the need arise
